Production: Mattress production typically takes about 3-5 business days, though more complex mattresses can take up to 3 weeks.
Delivery: Once shipped, ground deliveries with USPS or UPS can take anywhere from 2-5 business days to arrive.

Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, we do offer a price matching policy for price drops that occur after your purchase!
Price Matching Policy If the price of the same new item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we will refund the difference to your original form of payment.
Important Details:
This policy applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase — it does not apply to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available at the time you placed your order.
The item must be identical in model, size, and color, and it must be in stock at the time of the request.
The lower price must be publicly advertised and verifiable.
Only offers from authorized retailers qualify — we do not match prices from auction sites, marketplaces, resellers, or unauthorized retailers.
How to Request:
Contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date and provide proof of the lower advertised price. You'll receive an email confirmation upon approval, and the refunded amount may take several days to reflect based on your bank's processing times.
If you need to request a price match, I'd be happy to connect you with our team!
